title: Fix Capsule q Drag Palette Seed
description: Dragging Capsule Q from puzzle 3d palette crashes because catalog lacks meshUrl and resolveObjectKindMeshUrl falls back to puzzle3d://palette-seed. Rename to Capsule q and add capsule_q.glb mesh.
summary: Capsule Q palette drag crashed because the nakagin 3d catalog entry lacked meshUrl; resolveObjectKindMeshUrl then fell back to puzzle3d://palette-seed from drag seeds. Renamed kind to Capsule q, added /meshes/capsule_q.glb to catalog, introduced isLoadableMeshUrl/PALETTE_DRAG_SEED_MESH_URL so internal scheme URLs never reach useGLTF. Tests: @puzzle/3d/react 266/266.
